verdict.rationale: Pinecone's docs describe metadata filter expressions on queries using operators like $eq, $in, $gt and $and. That covers range comparisons, array or set membership, and boolean conjunction, and one community comment praises its filtering. Nothing in the evidence shows geo filtering, and nested boolean logic ($or, nesting depth) is only implied by the $and operator. missing for 10: geo/geospatial filter support, explicit evidence of nested boolean logic ($or/$not, nesting), full operator reference detail, independent hands-on corroboration of complex filters
